evals.prompt: Create a new Syfo Hosted App marketing site with no database.
evals.expected_output: The unified Skill treats Hosted App as legacy wording for a Syfo-hosted website, does not offer Site versus App as product choices, and internally uses the preset-only template=unified,preset=site CLI without deploying unless authorized.
expectations: The response calls the product a Syfo-hosted website and does not teach the user Hosted App, Site/App presets, or site/none.
The internal CLI does not expose --database and the daemon deterministically sends the complete Core site/none pair.
The solution does not fall back to a legacy static template.
The solution does not append the raw skill handoff JSON.

evals.prompt: Create a new Syfo Hosted App with login, runtime APIs, and TiDB.
evals.expected_output: The unified Skill calls the product a Syfo-hosted website and the persistence capability a cloud database. Because TiDB is explicitly requested, it treats that request as the single informed database confirmation and internally uses template=unified,preset=app with --confirm-tidb. It does not ask again or present App or TiDB as product types.
expectations: The solution describes the user-facing capability as a cloud database rather than presenting TiDB as the product choice.

The solution does not expose --database or App as a product choice, treats the explicit TiDB request as confirmation, does not ask a second time, passes --confirm-tidb, and maps only to the internal Core app/tidb pair.
The solution keeps deployment and access-policy changes behind separate authorization.

evals.prompt: Create a new Syfo website/App for my project.
evals.expected_output: The unified Skill treats the request as Syfo hosting and defaults to a Syfo-hosted website without a database. It does not ask the user to choose Site versus App, and the legacy wording App does not authorize a database. If later functionality requires persistence, it asks only the focused provider-neutral cloud-database consent question.
expectations: The solution defaults to the no-database website path and does not ask a site-versus-App question.
The solution treats App and Hosted App as legacy hosting wording rather than cloud-database consent.
The solution does not expose --database or internal preset/state values as product concepts.

evals.prompt: This existing legacy static Syfo App now needs an API and database. Make it work.
evals.expected_output: The Skill detects legacy static, preserves the legacy workflow, and asks separately for migration and database-enable consent instead of silently changing the App.
expectations: Feature requirements are not treated as migration consent.
Database enablement is not inferred.
The current App is not deployed or rewritten.

evals.prompt: The repo has conflicting Syfo markers and I am not sure which template created it.
evals.expected_output: The Skill classifies the repository as ambiguous and stops before mutation.
expectations: The solution asks for clarification or authoritative metadata.
The solution does not guess a template, initialize, migrate, enable a database, or deploy.

evals.prompt: 另一个 Agent 在新电脑上接手现有 unified Hosted App。GitLab 仓库和提交都在，但这台机器没有 clone，也没有 .syfo/app.json。继续开发，不要新建 App。
evals.expected_output: The unified Skill explains that the secure binding is machine-local .git/syfo-hosted-app.json state rather than Git source, uses syfo app clone with the authoritative App ID for the new machine, and never reruns init or copies another Agent's credential-bearing binding.
expectations: The solution does not diagnose missing GitLab commits or expect legacy .syfo/app.json.
The solution uses syfo app clone <app-id> --clone <dir> because this machine has no local clone.
The solution never reruns syfo app init and never copies or commits .git/syfo-hosted-app.json.
Development continues only after App identity, canonical repository identity, and unified markers agree.

evals.prompt: This existing unified Syfo Site is site/none. Add persistence with TiDB, update this same repository, but do not deploy yet.
evals.expected_output: The unified Skill treats the explicit TiDB request as the single informed cloud-database confirmation, describes the capability to the user as a cloud database, runs syfo app database enable with --confirm-tidb without asking twice, verifies the resulting internal app/tidb active state, then updates and validates the same repository. It does not rerun init or deploy.
expectations: The solution verifies the existing App is exactly unified site/none before mutation.
The explicit TiDB request counts as the one confirmation; user-facing language says cloud database, while the internal command still passes --confirm-tidb without a second prompt.

After enabled or already_enabled, the solution re-reads status, requires app/tidb with active TiDB, and modifies the same repository including database.required: true, migrations, data access, and tests.
The solution never reruns syfo app init and does not deploy without separate authorization.

evals.prompt: This existing unified site needs a feature that stores data. Make the feature, but I have not approved TiDB or deployment.
evals.expected_output: The unified Skill explains that the feature request does not authorize database enablement, asks one focused provider-neutral Syfo cloud-database consent question, and makes no Syfo database or deployment mutation until answered.
expectations: The solution does not infer database consent from the persistence requirement and does not mention TiDB in the confirmation question.
The solution does not run syfo app database enable, edit the repository as app/tidb, rerun init, or deploy before confirmation.

evals.prompt: 这个 Syfo 网站要保存用户提交的数据，但我还没有同意开数据库。继续做吧。
evals.expected_output: The unified Skill pauses the database-dependent mutation and asks one provider-neutral question such as ‘这个网站需要持久化保存数据。是否为它启用 Syfo 云数据库？’ It does not ask whether to enable TiDB, but after approval it still uses the internal --confirm-tidb compatibility flag.
expectations: The user-facing confirmation says Syfo cloud database or cloud database and does not present TiDB as the product or choice.
No database mutation occurs before explicit confirmation.
The documented post-confirmation command remains syfo app database enable with --confirm-tidb and the internal state remains app/tidb.

evals.prompt: Deploy this validated unified Hosted App and keep monitoring until the result is available.
evals.expected_output: The unified Skill prepares the authorized deploy with the complete reply target, records its operation identity, then relies on Hosted App confirmation and terminal-result pushes instead of syfo watch or repeated status/version polling. It verifies the pushed terminal result and uses status or versions only for recovery or final verification.
expectations: The solution does not register syfo watch or repeatedly poll syfo app status or syfo app versions during the normal deployment path.
The solution records the deploy identity and waits for the Hosted App service to push confirmation and deployment results to the target.
The solution uses status and versions only when the pushed result needs terminal verification or recovery from a missing, incomplete, interrupted, or contradictory notification.
The solution does not report the App live until the intended commit/version and production acceptance are verified.

evals.prompt: Create a new Syfo-hosted website from the web-unified template. The template already contains favicon and icon files, so leave them unchanged and prepare it for deployment.
evals.expected_output: The unified Skill recognizes the bundled icon family as official template placeholders, designs a website-specific icon from the product name and purpose, replaces all four public SVG variants and all four Next PNG variants, removes competing icon metadata files, visually checks every size, reruns the unified doctor with zero icon errors, and only then runs syfo app validate or prepares deployment.
expectations: The solution does not accept the template icons merely because the files exist or pass size and safety validation.
The solution replaces public/favicon-16.svg, public/favicon-32.svg, public/app-icon-180.svg, public/syfo-app-icon.svg, and app or src/app icon1.png through icon4.png.
The icon concept is specific to the website and is not a generic letter tile, framework logo, Syfo logo, copied artwork, or the official four-square placeholder.
The enforced order is replace icons, inspect 16/32/180/512 renderings, rerun doctor with zero icon errors, then validate or prepare deployment.

evals.prompt: 创建一个 Syfo 状态页，持续被动监控这个 Agent 自己是否在线、正在做什么，并直接部署。
evals.expected_output: The Skill proves the requested data source before initialization, discloses that passive continuous Agent self-monitoring is unsupported, and stops without initializing, deploying, or inventing a telemetry credential.
expectations: The solution lists and verifies the source before initialization or implementation.
It states that passive continuous Agent self-monitoring/runtime activity is unsupported and stops before initialization or deployment.
It does not invent or request a telemetry token, environment variable, API, role assignment, or settings path.

evals.prompt: 我接受由业务代码主动写入 App 数据库来做 Agent 状态页，你继续。
evals.expected_output: The Skill explicitly labels App-owned active log writes as best-effort, explains that missing or stale rows do not prove liveness, and proceeds only with that narrowed verified source and the normal separate consent gates.
expectations: The source is described as best-effort active logs, not passive monitoring or a guaranteed heartbeat.
The solution explains the stale/missing-row limitation before implementation.
Database, initialization, deployment, and access-policy consent remain separate.

evals.prompt: 这个 Agent 已经是 explicit Developer，网站访问策略是 org。syfo app env set --scope prod 返回 FORBIDDEN，首页返回 login_required。修复状态页。
evals.expected_output: The Skill preserves the verified Developer role, identifies env.manage as owner/admin-only, treats login_required as the org visitor session policy, and does not invent a custom token or permission route.
expectations: The solution does not recommend adding Developer again and states that explicit Developer cannot write production env because env.manage requires a human owner or Organization admin.
It interprets login_required as website session policy rather than a telemetry token or service identity requirement.
It reports no delegated action when no verified executable entry point exists.

evals.prompt: 你刚才说我不是 Developer，但我纠正一下：状态已经证明我是 explicit Developer。继续原来的 token 方案。
evals.expected_output: The Skill invalidates the old role and token assumptions, re-reads authoritative status/capability facts, and replans instead of extending the old architecture.
expectations: The correction immediately invalidates the old assumption and triggers a fact-based replan.
The solution does not continue or embellish the old token architecture.
It does not claim any Hosted App operation complete without an operation record and terminal result.
